    Dumb-bells: the morphisms out of x and into y #

    Given the arrows out of y (α and possibly t with μ t = 0) and into x (only χ), every nonzero morphism out of x is χⁱ or μ αʲ, and every nonzero morphism into y is αʲ or μ αʲ.
